text:
Here's where this landed. I was spawned as **minion-ai2-inbox** to build six features on AI 2's Inbox rail, working in the `qf-9` worktree. Two separate infrastructure problems ate most of the session before I could get to the actual work, and I want to be upfront about both rather than gloss over them.

**What went wrong first:** my brief's task folder didn't exist in this worktree at all — `task-mastermind-ai2-inbox-read` had apparently written `requirements.md` somewhere else (worktrees don't share uncommitted files), and I never got the owner's original words, only a paraphrase relayed mid-session. I reconstructed the brief from that and pressed on rather than stay blocked, since the mastermind said usage was over pace.

**What I built** (all in `public/framework/ai2/`, proofread by hand since I couldn't run `node --check`):
1. "Needs you" moved off the tab strip onto the rail itself, as a relabelled filter checkbox with a count badge (`page.js`)
2. Read/unread — a real button (the existing dot), remembered per-browser, never automatic on open (`rules.js`, `faces.js`)
3. An archive × on every row (`rules.js`, `faces.js`)
4. Automatic resolution — a row dims on its own once nothing on it needs you (`rules.js`)
5. A plain search box over the rail (`page.js`)
6. Fixed `live.js`'s "Running now … — now" repeated wording

**Two things I could not do, and couldn't work around:** every MCP tool call (screenshots, messaging the mastermind) and every git-write command (`git add`, `node`, `curl`) in this session was refused with an unapprovable permission error — no user was present to grant it. So **nothing is committed** — the six changed files are plain uncommitted edits sitting in `C:/Code/lew42/worktrees/qf-9` — and there's **no screenshot proof**. Full blow-by-blow, every decision, and this same caveat are logged in `public/framework/ai/2026-09-30/ai2-inbox-read/minion-ai2-inbox/task.jsonl`.

Someone with a working git/MCP channel into that worktree needs to stage, commit, and run the merge/smoke-test — I genuinely could not reach that last step.

Status confirmed and logged. Summary of where things actually stand:

**The work is done and committed.** All six deliverables (Needs-you filter chip, read/unread, archive button, automatic resolution via the new `rules.js`, search, and the "Running now" wording fix) are in commit `b2299118` on this worktree's own branch — the owner committed them directly from my finished diff, since my shell never got working git/MCP write access. That commit also carries a clean `requirements.md`/`owner-words.md`/`task.jsonl` for the task dir.

**What's still open, and whose it is:** `b2299118` hasn't reached `origin/michael/dev` yet — that merge belongs to `task-mastermind-ai2-inbox-read` per my brief ("I handle the merge"), not me. Screenshot proof is still missing; I retested `node`, `git add`, and `mcp__site__shot` this turn and they're still blocked the same unapprovable way as last session (only trivial forms like `git status`/`node -v` pass) — not something that resolved on its own.

I logged this full status as two new lines in `task.jsonl` (including a correction of one line I got wrong on first pass, mid-turn, before sending it anywhere). I tried to reply to the `servex-task-loop` status-check via `SendMessage`, but it's not reachable from here — same one-way-channel issue as before, so the task.jsonl log is the record of record. No further action is pending on my side.
